name: The Warrior's Path
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
narrative.objectives: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
narrative.offerRewardText: You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.Good luck, Zaelriel, may the winds guide you.
narrative.requestItemsText: So you've come for training, then?
